repository_structure.scope: 6 release files, 19 checked Markdown files, 6 original evaluation cases

claim_checker_regressions.scope: Temporary integrity fixtures; not model evaluation outcomes.

frozen_claim_reviews.scope: Schema, coverage, references, hashes and exact quotation integrity, not an automated semantic verdict.

checks: Frozen inputs, contract, skill snapshots, current skill, raw outputs, anonymous packets and reviews match their recorded hashes.
12 fresh outputs and 20 indexed previous/current review documents cover all planned conditions.
Historical run files are unchanged; the archived v0.3.0 report body matches the previous committed report byte for byte.
All 19 full Markdown document embeds are exact copies of the raw sources.
The offline HTML contains 24 raw documents and 8 raw inputs, all download bytes and 40 source hashes match; no remote assets are loaded.
Every published before/after excerpt is a contiguous raw v0.3.0 or v0.4.0 quotation.
Two separately built v0.4.0 packages are byte-identical.

results: Static contents: eight cases, 24 document articles, eight input blocks, 32 download buttons
All HTML IDs are unique and every local fragment / ARIA target resolves
Each footnote reference and backlink stays inside the same document
Initialization, valid case hashes, invalid hashes, and malformed URI hashes
Eight tab click handlers update selection, roving tabindex, hidden panels and case hash
Arrow keys wrap, Home/End select endpoints, focus follows selection, unrelated keys are untouched
Comparison/view changes preserve the chosen case and update labels and status for all eight cases
CSS display-rule analysis: correct visible conditions for all cases, six selections, three widths and screen/print
No-JavaScript display-rule analysis keeps all 24 documents available
Hashchange switches valid cases and does not disrupt the current case for a clicked footnote
All 32 download handlers produce Blob bytes matching source files and SHA-256; anchors attach/remove; URLs revoke after scheduled delay
Regression: opening/reloading footnote and backlink fragments selects their case; hashchange preserves each fragment
limitations: Node VM with DOM doubles; no real browser, layout, native focus/scroll, screen reader, download dialog, or print rendering was exercised.
CSS inspection evaluates display rules, media predicates, specificity, and ancestor visibility only; it does not measure overflow.
